decision: Extract mission/runtime reliability first, keep exact snapshot rollback on persistence failure, and measure its queue-size cost with a deterministic local benchmark gate before scaling the queue.

included: exact in-memory rollback when persistence fails
worker session fencing and restart recovery
rollback snapshot benchmark and focused regression tests

reviews.reason: failed durable mutations must never remain visible in memory
restores the last durable state while preventing later writes after persistence failure

reviews.preferred: retain local snapshot rollback but add queue-size p95 measurement
reviews.reason: snapshot cloning has the smallest infrastructure/regression surface, but its O(queue-size) cost must be measured before large queues are allowed

alternatives.approach: leave mutated memory in place and only poison later writes
alternatives.rejectedBecause: reads can expose state the durable store rejected
adds failure-path I/O and a second failure mode exactly when storage is unhealthy
adds latency, operational resources and migration risk before multi-process scale requires it

alternatives.approach: replace full snapshots with mutation deltas immediately
alternatives.rejectedBecause: reduces clone cost but substantially increases rollback complexity and regression risk before benchmark evidence shows the optimization is needed

gates: benchmark budget evaluator fails closed when a queue-size budget is absent or exceeded

benchmark.method: warm in-memory MissionQueue, snapshot repeatedly, report p50/p95/max by queue size
benchmark.interpretation: planning/lab budgets, not production SLOs; revise only from measured evidence on the target runtime

failuresAndLessons: The first fail-closed design poisoned later writes but did not roll back the failed mutation.
Restart recovery semantics cannot be reused blindly for rollback because running work may be requeued.
Full snapshot rollback is simple and robust but scales linearly with queue size, so performance must be measured rather than assumed.
lessons: Keep Qubes transport out of this dependency-root slice.
Retain the original regression suite in extracted slices.
Fail-closed includes visibility of failed mutations, not only rejection of later writes.
Do not optimize rollback into deltas until benchmark evidence demonstrates the clone cost is material.
